user_prompt: Which of my live Klaviyo flows generated the most attributed revenue in the last 30 days?
judge_criteria: The answer identifies a single specific flow by name or ID as the top-revenue flow.
Revenue is reported as a concrete dollar amount (not a range or qualitative descriptor).
The window matches the asked period — last 30 days.
Only live (currently active) flows are considered, not draft or archived.
Numbers are aggregated across all messages in the flow — not a single message's revenue presented as the flow's total.
notes: Baseline single-turn reporting-endpoint task. Hits flow-values-reports. The aggregation criterion catches the per-message vs per-flow bug that v1.0.4 docs addressed.
